description: This is a unit test class for 'RetrieveAttributeStrategy' in the Eclipse Ditto project. It tests the behavior of retrieving attributes from a 'Thing' entity, including existing, non-existing, and absent attributes.

classes.name: RetrieveAttributeStrategyTest
classes.description: Unit test class for the RetrieveAttributeStrategy, verifying attribute retrieval behaviors in various scenarios.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of RetrieveAttributeStrategy before each test.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that instances of RetrieveAttributeStrategy are immutable.

methods.name: retrieveExistingAttribute
methods.description: Tests retrieving an existing attribute from a Thing entity and checks the correct response.

methods.name: retrieveAttributeFromThingWithoutAttributes
methods.description: Tests retrieval from a Thing that has no attributes, expecting an exception.

methods.name: retrieveNonExistingAttribute
methods.description: Tests retrieving a non-existent attribute, expecting an attributeNotFound exception.
